e-stop latency on bench bot #2, big red press -> motor torque off: 118ms avg, 160ms worst case. req is <=50ms. looks like the press goes through the main loop before it hits the MDB enable. that's... not how it's supposed to work
wait, big red isn't hardwired to the enable line? it is in the schematic
it's on the STO pin on rev B, but on rev A it's just a GPIO i think. need to check which rev sandwich is on #2
#2 has a rev A sandwich. rev B is what goes into DVT so we need a number on rev B before anyone relaxes
this has to be closed before DVT, it's a safety req. Dani/Marcus can you get a rev B number by mon?
